Flatpickr 4.6.13 (MIT), vendored locally for offline Thai date selection.

Source: https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr/tree/v4.6.13
Distribution: npm package `flatpickr@4.6.13` (`dist/flatpickr.min.js`,
`dist/flatpickr.min.css`, `dist/l10n/th.js`, `LICENSE.md`).

Application integration: `/js/calendar.js` and `/css/calendar.css`.
The calendar displays Thai months and Gregorian years; submitted values remain
ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. Mobile native pickers are disabled to preserve Thai month names.
